name: DEFGDGB.jcl
description:
This JCL job defines six Generation Data Group (GDG) bases for the CardDemo application, establishing versioned data storage structures for transaction backups, daily transactions, transaction reports, category balance backups, system transactions, and combined transactions. Each GDG is configured to retain a maximum of 5 generations, with older generations automatically scratched (deleted) when the limit is exceeded. If a GDG already exists (condition code 12), the error is suppressed to allow safe re-execution.Key Functionalities:
Defines a GDG base named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.BKUP with a limit of 5 generations and automatic scratch of oldest generation upon overflow, used for transaction backup data.
Defines a GDG base named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.DALY with a limit of 5 generations and automatic scratch, used for daily transaction data.
Defines a GDG base named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANREPT with a limit of 5 generations and automatic scratch, used for transaction reports.
Defines a GDG base named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.BKUP with a limit of 5 generations and automatic scratch, used for transaction category balance backup data.
Defines a GDG base named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.SYSTRAN with a limit of 5 generations and automatic scratch, used for system transaction data.
Defines a GDG base named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.COMBINED with a limit of 5 generations and automatic scratch, used for combined transaction data.
Suppresses condition code 12 (already exists error) for each GDG definition, ensuring the job completes successfully even if the GDG bases were previously defined.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CardDemo system requires versioned storage management for transaction backup data and the system catalog is accessible
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to register the Transaction Backup versioned file group (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.BKUP) in the catalog
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: 1. The Transaction Backup versioned file group is registered in the system catalog. 2. The group is configured to retain a maximum of 5 versions at any time. 3. When a new version is added and the total count exceeds 5, the oldest version is automatically deleted from the system without manual intervention. 4. If the Transaction Backup versioned file group already exists in the catalog, the registration attempt is treated as successful and processing continues to the next file group registration without raising an error.

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Register Transaction Backup Versioned File Group
rules.Rule_Description: Registers the Transaction Backup versioned file group in the system catalog, enforcing a maximum of 5 retained versions with automatic deletion of the oldest version, while allowing safe re-registration if the group already exists.
